reading.title: The Green Club
reading.text: Our school has a new Green Club. About twenty students care about the environment and meet every Thursday. Last month they cleaned a small river near the school, because rubbish was harming the natural environment there. Next week the club will plant trees in the school yard. reading.title: A Dirty Beach
reading.text: Last Saturday our class went to clean a beach. When we arrived, we saw a huge pile of rubbish near the rocks. There were bottles, plastic bags and old paper. Our teacher explained that water pollution is dangerous for fish and birds. We threw away the rubbish in big bags and put the glass and paper in different bins to recycle. It took three hours, but the beach looked beautiful again. Everyone agreed that it was not a waste of time.

reading.title: After the Flood
reading.text: Last spring the river near Rano's village flooded after a week of heavy rain. The flood water covered the fields and many roads. The radio had given a flood warning, so families left their houses early and went to the school on the hill. Rescue workers brought food, blankets and clean water. After three days the water went down, and people began to repair the damage. Rano says she will never forget how kind everyone was during those days.

listening.script: Teacher: Listen carefully. If an earthquake hits while we are in class, do not run outside. Go under your desk and hold on to it. Pupil: What if the shaking is very strong? Teacher: Stay there until it stops. Aftershocks can come later, so wait for me to say that it is safe. Then we leave the building and meet in the yard. Our town is in an earthquake zone, so it is important to practise this drill every term.

reading.title: Caught in a Storm
reading.text: Last Sunday Ali and his father went hiking in the hills. In the morning the sky was clear, but by noon storm clouds covered the sun. Soon a violent storm began, with strong wind and heavy rain. They were caught far from the village, so they took shelter under a large rock. The thunder was very loud, and Ali felt nervous. After an hour the storm passed. They walked home slowly, wet but safe. Next time they will listen to the weather forecast before they go.

reading.title: After the Wind
reading.text: Last night a strong wind blew across our street. This morning we saw the damage. A large tree had fallen on the garage, and there was some damage to the roof. Luckily nobody was inside. Our neighbour's car also had minor damage because a branch hit the window. Dad called the insurance company, and a man came to look at the roof. He said that the insurance covers the damage, but the repair will take two weeks. In the meantime, we are keeping the bikes in the kitchen.
